role.en: PhD candidate in Food Science and Engineering at Jiangnan University, on a joint PhD program at the National University of Singapore since 2025. Graduating in June 2027.
role.zh: 江南大学食品科学与工程博士在读，2025 年起在新加坡国立大学联合培养，2027 年 6 月毕业。

bio.en: My PhD project is on the flavor of human milk; my master's project was on beef flavor from Maillard reactions of beef tallow residue. I analyse samples with GC-MS, GC-O, electronic nose and sensory panels, and model the data with machine learning. During my PhD I wrote a GC-MS data-processing program that is now used routinely for research data; it has processed more than 3,000 samples.
bio.zh: 我的博士课题是母乳风味，硕士做的是牛油渣美拉德反应产生的牛肉风味。平时用 GC-MS、GC-O、电子鼻和感官评价做分析，再用机器学习建模。读博期间我写了一套 GC-MS 数据处理程序，已用于日常科研数据处理，累计处理 3000 多个样品。
